description: T4: a complete Hermes call interrupted by a reasoning block before its </tool_call>, which is written right after the block: the block is no wrapper text (reasoning bytes belong to the block), so the call is read with its wrapper closer inserted before the block (tool_call.markup.missing-wrapper-close, the only reading, as before another call's opener), and the closer after the block is the call's own, recorded on it as a stray closer (tool_call.markup.stray-closer), never content. Before T4 the block was taken for text inside the wrapper and the call was rejected.
